theater: 河南道雍丘城與睢陽道

battle.name: 雍丘之戰
battle.theater: 河南道雍丘城與睢陽道
battle.brief: 安史之亂席捲河南，叛軍將領令狐潮率精騎萬餘圍攻睢陽道中段的雍丘。縣令張巡以不足千人的義兵據城，束蒿為炬夜焚敵營，以弩手壓住敵騎，迫令狐潮退屯鄆州。卡面的羅馬扭力弩砲靠蓄能取射程，唐代並無其物；守城所用床弩、擘弩與飛石則是同一條技術路線的東方樣子。雍丘若失，睢陽便無遮蔽。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 雍丘之戰是安史之亂中唐軍與大燕叛軍在河南道東部的第一次正面拉鋸，爆發在叛軍席捲河洛、玄宗西幸蜀地的同時。交戰一方是唐朝的勤王軍與地方義軍：雍丘縣令張巡自陳留率領的義兵數百人，加上陳留、滑州、汴州一線陸續歸附的團練，編制並不統一，沒有可靠後方，糧秣全靠城內存糧與臨時徵集。另一方是安祿山在建國大燕之後派出的河南部隊，主將令狐潮，麾下是攻取陳留以後跟著南下的精騎萬餘，裝備與糧秣靠洛陽、陳留一線的叛軍據點供給。戰役的地理意義在雍丘的位置：它位於睢水下游、睢陽道的中段，往北五十餘里是睢陽，往西經陳留、汴州可通洛陽，一旦雍丘被叛軍占住，洛陽方面就能沿睢水與汴渠直取商丘、睢陽，再順著漕渠直下江淮。唐廷在這個方向上唯一能倚仗的，就是睢陽道上的幾座小城與這支自發集結的義軍。叛軍的計畫是速戰速決，用騎兵優勢碾平縣城；唐軍的計畫是死守、拖住，把河南戰局拖到西軍反攻。
countriesEn: The Battle of Yongqiu was the first stand-and-counterattack between the Tang forces and the Yan rebels in eastern Henan, fought while the rebellion was still sweeping the Luo valley and the emperor was fleeing west to Shu. On one side were the Tang loyalist troops and local militia: the several hundred volunteers that Zhang Xun had raised at Chenliu in his capacity as magistrate of Yongqiu, together with the tuan-lian contingents that attached themselves to him from Chenliu, Huazhou and Bianzhou. Their organisation was loose, they had no dependable rear, and their supply came from whatever grain the city held plus last-minute requisitioning. On the other side stood the Henan field army of the Great Yan state that An Lushan had proclaimed after taking Luoyang; its commander was Linghu Chao, and the troops he led south were more than ten thousand picked cavalry who had participated in the reduction of Chenliu, supplied from the Yan footholds along the Luoyang–Chenliu line. The strategic meaning of the battle lay in where Yongqiu stood: on the lower Sui waterway, midway along the Suoyang road, some fifty li south of Suoyang, and west of it by way of Chenliu and Bianzhou on the road to Luoyang. Once the rebels held Yongqiu, Luoyang could ride down the Sui river and the Bian canal to strike Shangqiu and Suoyang and then move down the grain canal toward Jiangnan. The only thing the Tang court had on this road was a handful of small cities and the militia that had raised itself. The rebel plan was to break the county quickly with their cavalry superiority; the Tang plan was to hold, to delay, and to keep the Henan front alive until the western armies came back.
people: 指揮雍丘守軍的是縣令張巡。他原本在清池、陳留一帶任職，叛軍過境時收攏散卒、召募義兵，把隊伍從數十人帶到數千人，兵器一半是鄉間自備的弓刀，一半是從陳留軍庫與民間搜羅的舊弩。天寶末年他調任雍丘，把城防、糧秣、井水與城門出入的次序一一定下，圍城之中仍照常點名、照常分糧。守將雷萬春是雍丘本地人，主城門一線；南霽雲是南陽人，與張巡同在陳留起兵，雍丘解圍後隨張巡轉入睢陽，後來單騎突出重圍向朝廷求援，見到哥舒翰，只求得數百人馬。叛軍一方，令狐潮是安祿山部下的驍將，作戰以騎兵突擊與夜襲見長；在他之後是尹子奇等一批河北將領，雍丘未下，便抽調大軍轉攻睢陽。朝廷方面，玄宗西幸蜀地，太子李亨即位靈武，是為肅宗；雍丘之捷的消息傳回之後，朝廷加張巡御史中丞，正式把這支河南義軍列入國家序列。另一個關鍵人物是賀蘭進明，他奉命率軍救援睢陽卻屯兵不進，使睢陽最終得不到外援。
peopleEn: The defence of Yongqiu was commanded by the magistrate Zhang Xun. He had earlier held office around Qingchi and Chenliu; when the rebels passed through he gathered scattered soldiers and recruited volunteers, growing a force from a few dozen men to several thousand, half of them equipped with bows and sabres brought from the villages and half with old crossbows salvaged from the Chenliu armoury and from private owners. Late in the Tianbao era he was transferred to Yongqiu, and there he fixed in advance the order of the city defence, the grain, the wells and the opening and closing of the gates, and kept the roll called and the rations divided even while the city was being invested. The garrison commander Lei Wanchun was a native of Yongqiu and held the gate line; Nan Ji Yun came from Nanyang and had risen with Zhang Xun at Chenliu, and after the relief of Yongqiu he followed Zhang Xun to Suoyang, later breaking out alone to seek aid from the court and being granted by Geshu Han only a few hundred men. On the rebel side, Linghu Chao was a noted lieutenant of An Lushan whose methods were the cavalry charge and the night attack; behind him stood commanders such as Yin Ziqi, who, finding Yongqiu ungoverned, drew the main body of the army away to besiege Suoyang. On the court side, the Xuanzong emperor had fled to Shu, and the crown prince Li Heng had taken the throne at Lingwu as Suzong; once the news of the victory at Yongqiu reached the capital the court gave Zhang Xun the additional post of censor-in-chief, formally putting the Henan volunteer army on the rolls of the state. The other figure who mattered was Helan Jinming, who was sent with troops to relieve Suoyang but sat still where he was, so that Suoyang in the end received no help.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲，是扭力蓄能的直射兵器：把成束的筋腱或獸毛絞成彈簧，藏進機框，扣上弩弦待發，射時釋放，一具一箭，靠的是長時間儲存的機械能而不是弓臂本身的拉力。羅馬人自第二次布匿戰爭之後把它帶進戰場，專門用來對付城牆上密集的人馬與攻城器械；到西羅馬帝國覆亡的第五世紀，這門技術在中西歐斷了線，直到近代火砲成熟之前都不曾再現。雍丘之戰裡當然沒有羅馬弩砲，唐朝在對應位置上的是弩砲一系：床弩、擘弩、弩臺，張力來源是弩機的機牙與望山，射程與張力介於弓和砲之間；攻城方還有飛石車、撞車、雲梯、巢車、木驢，守方則用撞杆、拒馬與火箭對付接近的雲梯。雍丘城頭真正發揮作用的是弓弩：張巡把善射者編在城上，專司壓住敵軍衝鋒的騎兵射界；城內糧盡之後，士兵採雀鼠、掘草根充飢，卻沒有一根弩弦放鬆，因為弦一鬆，弩就廢了。叛軍準備以撞車與木驢逼近城牆的企圖，也都被守方的火攻與弩箭擋了回去。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Roman scorpio, is a direct-firing machine that stores its power in torsion: skeins of sinew or animal hair are twisted into a spring, housed in a frame, the bowstring is drawn back and cocked, and the shot is released from the trigger — one bolt per machine, powered by mechanical energy stored over time rather than by the pull of the bow limbs themselves. The Romans took it into the field after the Second Punic War and used it specifically against dense bodies of men on city walls and against siege engines; when the Western Roman Empire collapsed in the fifth century the technique went out of use in western and central Europe and did not return before the coming of modern artillery. There was of course no Roman scorpio at Yongqiu. The Tang counterpart in the same functional slot was the family of crossbow artillery: bed crossbows, powerful hand-cranked crossbows and crossbow platforms, whose tension came from the trigger mechanism and the sight of the lock, with range and power falling between the bow and the true siege engine. The besiegers also had stone-throwers, battering rams, siege ladders, tower-baskets and covered ox-carts, while the defenders answered them with pole-beams, cheval-de-frise and fire-arrows. What actually did the work on the walls of Yongqiu were bows and crossbows: Zhang Xun posted his best shots along the wall to hold down the field of fire over the rebel cavalry's charge. When the city ran out of food the soldiers ate birds, mice and roots dug from the ground, yet not one crossbow string was let slack, because a slack string is a dead crossbow. Rebel attempts to bring battering rams and covered carts up against the wall were turned back by the defenders' fire and bolts.
tactics: 雍丘的守城打法，張巡和唐廷其他將領不同的地方，在於他不打算單靠城牆。令狐潮的騎兵在平原上無法展開，張巡便把戰鬥拉成三段：城頭弩手先射，壓住敵軍前鋒與衝鋒通道；城門開一條縫，由雷萬春率精兵出門血戰，把敵軍騎兵拖在城門下亂陣；剩下的兵在城內待命，一旦敵營安下來，就束起蒿草做火把，趁夜襲營，燒掉敵人新搭的帳幕與拴馬的草料。這個夜襲的關鍵不在人數，而在時機：叛軍連日攻城，人馬疲憊，又以為唐軍只會死守，戒備最鬆的正是夜裡。火起之後，張巡不等天亮就出城擊之，斬首數百級，叛軍前隊被衝散，軍隊退到鄆州一帶重整。這套打法之後被原封不動搬到睢陽：先以火攻與夜襲消耗敵軍，再死守孤城待機援軍。從整個河南戰局看，雍丘是一枚楔子，把叛軍的騎兵鋒芒釘在睢陽道中段，使洛陽與陳留兩面不能同時壓上睢陽。
tacticsEn: What set Zhang Xun's defence of Yongqiu apart from the methods of other Tang commanders was his refusal to rely on the wall alone. Linghu Chao's cavalry could not deploy on open ground, so Zhang Xun broke the fight into three stages. The crossbowmen on the wall fired first, holding down the rebel vanguard and the ground over which the charge would come. A gate was then opened a hand's breadth, and Lei Wanchun led a picked body out to fight at the gate mouth, pulling the rebel horse into disorder directly under the walls. The rest of the garrison waited inside, and as soon as the enemy camp settled for the night they tied bundles of brushwood into torches and struck the camp in the dark, burning the newly raised tents and the fodder the horses were tethered on. The heart of the night raid was not the numbers but the moment: the rebels had stormed for days on end, men and horses were exhausted, and they had assumed the Tang would only sit and take it, so the slackest watch of the whole campaign was after dark. Once the fires were up Zhang Xun did not wait for daylight but went out and struck, cutting down several hundred men and scattering the rebel vanguard, and the army pulled back to the neighbourhood of Yunzhou to reform. The same method was later carried to Suoyang unchanged: wear the enemy down with fire and night attacks first, then hold the isolated city and wait for relief. In the wider Henan picture Yongqiu was a wedge, pinning the rebel cavalry in the middle of the Suoyang road so that Luoyang and Chenliu could not press on Suoyang at the same time.
data: 關於兵力，史料留下的數字要打折扣看。令狐潮圍雍丘時所領的兵，記作精騎萬餘；雍丘守軍則只有張巡自陳留帶出的義兵數百人，加上城內團練，總數不過千人上下，兵力比例接近十比一。圍城歷時約兩個月，張巡以夜襲破敵，斬首數百級，史書對這一戰的斬首數另有數千一說。戰役真正的代價出現在後面：叛軍放棄雍丘後立刻合兵十三萬圍睢陽，張巡、許遠以六千八百人守城，自十月到次年正月苦守三個月，糧盡之後掘地取食，最後城破，張巡與南霽雲等數十人殉城，一支河南義軍至此全滅。距離與速度也值得一提：雍丘距陳留六十餘里、距睢陽五十餘里、距汴州近百里，正當汴渠與睢水交會處，往南可達柘縣，往東可達宋州；叛軍騎兵自洛陽南下，沿汴渠行軍一日可至。同一條睢陽道上，援軍與糧秣卻遲遲不來，賀蘭進明的援軍屯在昌邑不進，是睢陽最終陷落最直接的原因之一。
dataEn: The numbers that survive in the sources on the forces involved need to be taken with a discount. Linghu Chao is recorded as leading more than ten thousand picked cavalry in the investment of Yongqiu; the garrison there was the several hundred volunteers Zhang Xun had brought from Chenliu plus the city militia, some thousand men in all, so the ratio of force was close to ten to one. The siege lasted about two months, and Zhang Xun broke the enemy with a night raid that cut down several hundred men; the histories also give a figure of several thousand for the same action. The real cost of the campaign came afterwards: after giving up Yongqiu the rebels concentrated every unit they could draw together, thirteen myriads of men in the figure the sources give, and besieged Suoyang, where Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held the city with sixty-eight hundred men from the tenth month to the first month of the next year, three months of starvation and digging in the ground for food, until the city fell and Zhang Xun, Nan Ji Yun and several dozen others died in the breach; the Henan volunteer army was wiped out. Distances and rates of movement matter as well: Yongqiu lay some sixty li from Chenliu, some fifty li from Suoyang and close to a hundred li from Bianzhou, exactly where the Bian canal and the Sui waterway meet, with Zhe County to the south and Song Prefecture to the east; rebel horse could ride south from Luoyang along the Bian canal and arrive in a day. On that same Suoyang road, however, neither relief troops nor supplies came in time — Helan Jinming's relief army sat at Changyi and did not advance — and that is one of the most direct reasons Suoyang finally fell.
cause: 雍丘之戰是安史之亂的產物，也是這場叛亂第一次真正的戰役層級。天寶十四載十一月，安祿山在范陽起兵，河北諸州望風而叛，十二月至次年正月河洛震動；至德元年正月安祿山陷洛陽，自稱雄武皇帝，國號大燕。七月，哥舒翰在靈寶為叛軍所破，潼關失守，長安不守，玄宗西幸蜀地，太子李亨即位靈武，唐朝的中央政令一時斷在黃河兩岸。就在這個空檔，叛軍的河南部隊沿汴渠、睢水一路南下，要把睢陽道打通，一路可抵商丘、彭城，一路可接江淮的漕運。雍丘正卡在這條道上：縣小、兵少、糧薄，按常理守不住，叛軍只需一日就能把它踏平。張巡卻不願退。陳留既失，雍丘再失，睢陽就變成沒有遮蔽的城；他不願讓出通道，於是以縣令之身自募義兵，把城防經營成一次有組織的抵抗。叛軍方面的急躁也是原因之一：安祿山在洛陽站穩腳跟後，急於在主力尚能集中時解決河南，以騰出兵力去應付西面。雍丘之戰正是這份急躁撞上一座不打算讓路的城。
causeEn: The Battle of Yongqiu was a product of the An Lushan rebellion, and it was the first real campaign-level engagement of that rising. In the eleventh month of the fourteenth year of Tianbao, An Lushan raised his banner at Fanyang; the prefectures of Hebei fell away from the court almost without a fight, and from the twelfth month into the next January the Luo valley shook. In the first month of the Zhide era An Lushan took Luoyang, proclaimed himself emperor of Great Yan and set up a state. In the seventh month Geshu Han was beaten at Lingbao, Tong Pass was lost, Chang'an could not be held, the Xuanzong emperor fled west to Shu, and the crown prince Li Heng took the throne at Lingwu; for a time the central authority of the Tang was cut in two on either side of the Yellow River. Into that gap the rebel Henan armies rode south along the Bian canal and the Sui waterway, determined to open the Suoyang road, one branch running to Shangqiu and Pengcheng, the other reaching the grain shipments of Jiangnan. Yongqiu sat squarely on that road: a small county with few soldiers and thin stores, which by any normal reckoning could not be held, and which the rebels expected to flatten in a single day. Zhang Xun was unwilling to give ground. With Chenliu already lost, the loss of Yongqiu would leave Suoyang with no cover at all, and he was not prepared to hand over the corridor; so, as a mere magistrate, he raised volunteers on his own account and turned the defence of the county into an organised resistance. Impatience on the rebel side was part of the cause as well: once An Lushan was established at Luoyang he was in a hurry to settle Henan while his main force could still be concentrated, so as to free troops for the western front. The battle of Yongqiu was that impatience running into a town that was not intending to move.
impact: 雍丘之捷的意義，起初看起來不大：救回來的是一座縣城，幾百個人。但在安史之亂的河南戰場上，它第一次證明叛軍並非不能被打敗。令狐潮退兵之後，張巡得以據實上表，肅宗授他御史中丞，義軍從叛亂中的散兵變成朝廷名下的正式部隊，河南各縣的團練開始往睢陽道上集結。更要緊的是時間：雍丘把叛軍的騎兵拖住，等到至德二年秋西軍反攻、洛陽收復的反攻契機出現，叛軍腹背受敵，兵力被迫分散，這才有了睢陽之圍的僵局。反過來看，雍丘的守法也把代價推到最高：它用一支義軍的性命換來了幾十天的時間，而被換下來的那支隊伍最後在睢陽全滅；睢陽陷落之後叛軍一度打算沿運河直下江淮，正是唐廷最怕的結局。歷史書寫裡，雍丘常被當作睢陽之戰的前奏，兩場合起來才構成安史之亂中最著名的一次死守。雍丘的意義因此不在戰果，而在它顯示了唐代中期地方軍隊在沒有援軍的情況下，能把一座土城守成怎樣。
impactEn: At first sight the meaning of the victory at Yongqiu looks small: what was saved was a county town and a few hundred men. On the Henan battlefield of the An Lushan rebellion, however, it was the first proof that the rebels could be beaten. After Linghu Chao withdrew, Zhang Xun was able to report the matter in person, the Suzong emperor made him censor-in-chief, the volunteers ceased to be a band of scattered men in a rebellion and became a regular unit on the rolls of the state, and the tuan-lian of the Henan counties began to gather along the Suoyang road. More important still was time: Yongqiu held the rebel cavalry in place until the counter-offensive came in the autumn of the second year of Zhide and Luoyang was retaken, the rebels were caught between two fronts and their strength was forced to disperse, and only then did the stalemate at Suoyang set in. Looked at the other way, the defence of Yongqiu also carried the cost as far as it would go: it bought a few tens of days with the lives of one volunteer army, and the army that was relieved in this way was annihilated in the end at Suoyang. After Suoyang fell the rebels briefly talked of riding straight down the canal into Jiangnan, which was exactly the outcome the Tang court most feared. In later historical writing Yongqiu is usually treated as the prelude to the siege of Suoyang, and the two together make up the most famous stand of the An Lushan rebellion. The significance of Yongqiu therefore lies less in its results than in what it showed about what a mid-Tang provincial force could do to an earthen city when no relief was coming.
result: 雍丘沒有失守，但戰役的結果並不是一場乾淨的勝利。令狐潮的精騎在夜襲與出城反擊中受挫，部眾潰散，軍隊退保鄆州，雍丘城得保，張巡得以把這支義軍完整地帶到睢陽；朝廷隨後任命他掌管睢陽，把守住睢陽的任務交給他。可同一時間，叛軍把能抽調的兵力全部集中起來，由尹子奇率大軍轉攻睢陽，自至德二年十月起合圍，斷絕糧道。張巡在城上又撐了三個月，最後一點糧食吃完，援軍不至，城破，張巡、許遠、南霽雲等皆死，數十名殘部隨之殉城。叛軍拿下睢陽，卻沒有得到一個可以迅速轉化為勝勢的河南：西軍在河陽、洛陽一線站住了腳，叛軍的南進被阻在運河北端，江淮得以保全，朝廷在至德二年秋得以反攻並收復兩京。由此看，雍丘之戰的直接結果是唐軍守住了睢陽道的第一道門，而它在戰略層面的真正結果，要到睢陽陷落與洛陽收復之後才看得清楚。
resultEn: Yongqiu was not lost, but the outcome of the campaign was not a clean victory. Linghu Chao's picked cavalry took a beating in the night raid and the counter-stroke out of the gate, the formation broke up, and the army fell back to hold at Yunzhou; the city of Yongqiu survived, and Zhang Xun was able to bring the volunteer band there intact. The court then put him in charge of Suoyang and gave him the task of holding it. At the same moment, however, the rebels concentrated every unit they could draw together, Yin Ziqi led them against Suoyang, and from the tenth month of the second year of Zhide the city was invested and its supply route cut. Zhang Xun held on the walls for three more months; when the last of the food was eaten and no relief came, the city fell, and Zhang Xun, Xu Yuan, Nan Ji Yun and the rest were killed, with several dozen survivors dying with them. The rebels took Suoyang, but they did not gain a Henan that could be turned quickly into a winning position: the western armies held the line at Heyang and Luoyang, the southern thrust of the rebels was checked at the northern end of the canal, Jiangnan was preserved, and in the autumn of the second year of Zhide the court was able to counter-attack and recover both capitals. In that sense the direct result of the battle of Yongqiu was that the Tang held the first gate of the Suoyang road, while its true result at the strategic level only became clear after the fall of Suoyang and the recovery of Luoyang.
